translation: Remove the medicine and apply Wan Ling Ointment (萬靈膏), changing it once every three days. Wait until the pain stops and the person desires food, then remove the ointment and wash with He Shang Tang (和傷湯), whereby wind is dispelled, swelling disperses, blood quickens, and qi is regulated. If the flesh is broken and bleeding, first use horse's puffball ash (馬屁勃灰) to stop the bleeding; then use the elm bark moxibustion-ironing method (灸熨法), and internally take Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹) to strengthen the spleen and stomach, raise the primordial qi, stop thirst and generate fluids, increase spirit, and strengthen the body, so that the sinews and blood become harmonious and free-flowing.
